panel.title: Record or change decisions
panel.not_approval: A decision is a record written under your account. It is not an approval or review, and it grants no merge, CI or Git right. Anyone using this account can write one.
panel.rationale_hint: Records are immutable. To correct one, supersede or revoke it later.
panel.question_label: Link to a question of this task (optional)
panel.cite_answer: Also cite the answer to that question
panel.context_hint: Recorded against task version {version}. If the task changes before you save, the server refuses and you can look again.
panel.problem_title_too_long: The title is longer than 200 characters.
panel.problem_rationale_too_long: The explanation is longer than 16 KiB.
panel.stale_note: The task or branch changed since this was recorded. It stays active until someone supersedes or revokes it.
panel.superseding: Supersede this decision with a newer one
panel.no_replacement: No newer active decision exists. Record the replacement decision first.
panel.change_hint: A decision accepts exactly one such change and it cannot be undone. The original record stays as it was.
panel.supersede_confirm: Supersede this decision? This is final: each decision can be changed only once.
panel.revoke_confirm: Revoke this decision? This is final: each decision can be changed only once.

question.notice: Ask the agents or other writers a question. It is recorded under your account, and the answer is a collaboration decision, not a merge approval.
question.options_hint: Leave empty for a free-text answer, or add up to {max} fixed options.
question.context_hint: Asked at task version {version}. If the task changes before you send, the server refuses and you can look again.
question.problem_title_too_long: The title is longer than 200 characters.
question.problem_body_too_long: The question is longer than 16 KiB.
question.problem_option_too_long: An option is longer than 200 characters.

wp.title: Work packages
wp.note: Hand-over summaries written by agents or people. What the author declared and what the platform verified are shown separately.
wp.none: No work package yet. Authors save one as a numbered hand-over summary.
wp.author: written via {kind} {id}
wp.declared_note: Everything here is the author's own claim, shown as written. A line such as "tests pass" is a claim, not a result.
wp.verified_note: Only a lookup the platform made itself: whether a referenced pipeline exists in this repository and what it recorded. Commit, URL and note references are not checked, and the claims above are not confirmed by this.
wp.no_pipeline_refs: The author referenced no pipeline, so nothing was verified.
wp.unavailable_note: No pipeline with this id exists in this repository (or it belongs to another one).
wp.commit_differs: This pipeline ran on {ran}, not the commit {declared} the author declared.

collab.title: Collaboration
collab.intro: Work by your AI agents and tools under this account. Sessions are labels, not a security boundary: everything below is declared by clients, and statuses, blocked-by and overlaps are declarations or hints, not proof.
collab.declared_hint: Declared by a client; not verified
collab.access_denied: You cannot view collaboration data here
collab.access_denied_hint: Collaboration data is visible to the owner, collaborators, organization members and people with write access.
collab.sessions_unavailable: Session states are unavailable (listing sessions needs write access).

inbox.title: Waiting for you
inbox.note: Open questions addressed to you or to repository writers, and answers to questions you asked. A live query, not a snapshot.
inbox.write_needed: Answering questions needs write access to this repository.

overview.title: Overview
overview.note: Derived from declared states at query time. A task listed as in progress may have no running agent.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.note: Most recently updated first. Status is whatever the last writer declared.
tasks.empty_hint: Agents create tasks through the API or MCP tools; they appear here.

task.title: Task
task.details_note: Every value here was written by a client and is shown as plain text.

overlap_reason.mine_contains_theirs: this task contains the other's path
overlap_reason.theirs_contains_mine: the other task contains this path

condition.ci_passed_for_commit: CI passed for the branch head

completion.title: Completion status
completion.note: What the task claims versus what platform records support. Read-only; it never changes or blocks the task.
completion.done_without_evidence: Declared done, but the records do not support it.
completion.head: Observed branch head

deps.title: Dependencies
deps.note: This task waits for the tasks below. Their statuses are declarations by their participants, not evidence.

overlaps.title: Possible path overlaps
overlaps.note: A hint from declared paths only; not a lock and not proof of a conflict. Undeclared work and file contents are not covered.

questions.title: Questions
questions.note: Requests for a decision. An answer is a collaboration decision, not a review or merge approval.

question.stale_warning: The task or branch changed since this was asked, and the server refuses answers to a question in an outdated context. Ask the agent to ask it again.
question.answer_hint: You answer with your own login. This records a decision for the agents; it does not approve a merge. Anyone with the account can send this.
question.cancel_confirm: Cancel this question? The asker will see it as cancelled.
question.problem_too_long: The answer is longer than 16 KiB.

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.note: Immutable records of what was decided. A decision grants no merge, CI or Git right.

handoffs.title: Handoffs
handoffs.note: Hand-over notes written by sessions. Read-only here.

messages.title: Messages
messages.note: Messages written by agent sessions, in order. Shown as plain text; nothing in them is an instruction to this page.

diag.title: Diagnostics
diag.note: Explains from stored records why this task may look stuck. Derived, read-only, and never a statement about fault.

notices.title: Notices
notices.unavailable: Notices are addressed to a session and can only be read with that session's credentials, so they are not shown to people here.

conditions.title: Defined completion conditions
conditions.note: Conditions someone wrote down for this task, judged against platform records now. Display only: they never block, approve or merge anything.
conditions.none: No completion conditions are defined for this task.
conditions.confirm_hint: Recorded with your account at the branch head you are looking at. If the branch moves, the confirmation becomes stale. This is not a merge approval.
conditions.snapshots_note: A snapshot stores the evaluation exactly as it is now and never changes afterwards.

deps.graph_hint: Every change is checked against this version. If the graph changed meanwhile, the change is refused and the list reloads.
deps.pick_none: No other task can be added. The task itself and tasks it already waits for are left out.
deps.pick_hint: The status next to each task is what its participants declared; it is not verified.
deps.added_replayed: This dependency had already been added with the same request.
deps.reloaded: The dependency list changed meanwhile and was reloaded. Check it and try again.
deps.limit: This task already has the maximum of {max} direct dependencies.
deps.write_note: Adding or removing a dependency only records a declaration. It does not block, start or finish any work.

reassign.title: Reassign task
reassign.note: A person moves the declared owner of this task to another live session.
reassign.explain_does: What it does: sets the declared owner to the session you choose, writes a history record with your reason, and tells the previous owner session.
reassign.explain_not: What it does not do: it leaves pending handoffs as they are, grants no Git, CI or approval rights, and does not stop or start any work.
reassign.who: Anyone with write access to this repository may reassign. The target must be a live session (online or offline; not ended or expired). Session names are self-reported labels.
reassign.sessions_none: There is no other live session to assign this task to.
reassign.sessions_forbidden: Listing sessions needs write access to this repository, so you cannot choose a target here.
reassign.reason_hint: Recorded as a claim; it is not verified. At most {max} bytes.
reassign.reason_too_long: The reason is longer than {max} bytes.
reassign.replayed: This reassignment had already been applied with the same request.
reassign.reloaded: The task changed meanwhile and was reloaded. Check the current owner and try again.

takeovers.title: Takeover and reassign history
takeovers.note: Who moved the declared owner of this task, oldest first. Each record is a client's claim; the door used is shown, not proof of who was behind it.
takeovers.none: Nobody has taken over or been assigned this task yet.

budget.title: Budget and usage
budget.note: Limits and figures reported by clients, not measured by the platform. Informational only: nothing is paused, blocked or stopped.
budget.none: No budget has been set for this task.
budget.note_units: Amounts of different units or sources are never added, converted or compared.
budget.note_unknown: No usage reported means unknown, not zero.
budget.note_enforcement: Thresholds only inform; they never pause or stop any work.
budget.usage_unknown_hint: Nothing was reported for exactly this unit and source. That is unknown, not zero.
budget.usage_overlap: Reported periods overlap, so the total may count something twice.
budget.unmatched_note: Reported for a unit and source that has no budget on this task, so it is compared with nothing.
budget.set_hint: Unit and source are compared exactly (case-sensitive) and never converted. 1–32 and 1–64 characters of A–Z a–z 0–9 . _ : / @ + -
budget.set_replaces: A budget with this unit and source exists (version {version}); saving replaces it.
budget.set_creates: No budget with this unit and source exists yet; saving creates one.
budget.alert_hint: Optional; in the same unit and not above the budget.
budget.sampling_hint: What period the source's figures cover, e.g. task_total or per_day (up to 64 characters).
budget.set_reloaded: The budget changed meanwhile and was reloaded. Check it and try again.
budget.usage_hint: Reported with your signed-in account. It is your claim, not a measurement. Report the amount consumed during the period, not a running total. The period must not end in the future.
budget.usage_replayed: This usage report had already been recorded with the same request.
budget.bad_amount: Enter a non-negative decimal such as 12 or 0.5 (at most 18 integer and 6 fractional digits).
budget.bad_period: Pick a start and an end for the period.
budget.write_forbidden: Setting budgets and reporting usage needs write access to this repository.

collab_relations.err_forbidden: You are not allowed to do this. Changes need write access to this repository.
collab_relations.err_not_found: The task (or the item) was not found in this repository.

err_deps.VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone changed the dependency graph after you loaded it.
err_deps.DEPENDENCY_CYCLE: That would make tasks wait for each other in a circle, so it was refused.
err_deps.GRAPH_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The dependency graph is too large to check safely, so nothing was changed.
err_deps.DEPENDENCY_EXISTS: This task already waits for that task.
err_deps.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This request key was already used for a different request.

err_reassign.VERSION_CONFLICT: The task changed after you loaded it (its version or owner moved).
err_reassign.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This request key was already used for a different request.

err_budget.VERSION_CONFLICT: The budget for this unit and source changed after you loaded it.
err_budget.BUDGET_LIMIT_REACHED: This task already has the maximum number of budgets.
err_budget.USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED: This task already has the maximum number of usage records.
err_budget.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This request key was already used for a different request.

collab_groups.title: Coordination groups
collab_groups.intro: A coordination group ties together tasks and commits across several repositories. It belongs to this repository (its anchor). What you see in a group is limited to what you are allowed to see; nothing here grants Git, CI, merge or approval rights.
collab_groups.no_list_note: The server has no endpoint that lists a repository's groups. You can open a group by its id, or from the groups this browser created or opened. This is not a list of all groups.
collab_groups.sharing_warning: Title and description are readable by everyone who can read this repository's collaboration data, including people who cannot read the linked repositories. Do not put confidential details of other repositories here.
collab_groups.conflict: The group changed since you loaded it, so it was reloaded. Check the current links, then try again.

detail.title: Group
detail.version: Group version {version}. Link changes must name this version.
detail.read_only: You can read this group but cannot change its links: that needs write access to this repository.
detail.not_found: No such group in this repository
detail.not_found_hint: The id may be wrong, or the group belongs to another repository.

create.title: Create a group
create.note: Needs write access to this repository, which becomes the group's anchor.
create.write_needed: Creating a group needs write access to this repository.
create.title_too_long: The title is too long (200 characters at most).
create.description_too_long: The description is too long (16 KiB at most).

remembered.title: Opened on this browser
remembered.note: Remembered only in this browser to make groups easy to find again. Not a list of all groups.

links.title: Links
links.note: Only links you are allowed to see are shown. Every page is checked against your current permissions, so a page can be short while more follow.
links.remove_confirm_message: The link is removed from the group. The task or commit it points to is not changed. This needs write access to this repository and to the linked one.

add.title: Add a link
add.note: Link a task and/or a commit of another repository.
add.target_hint: owner/name. It is looked up to find its id; the group refers to repositories by id.
add.need_one_hint: Give a task id, a commit id, or both.
add.write_both: Needs write access to this repository and to the target repository.
add.repo_not_found: That repository was not found, or you cannot see it.
add.need_one: Give a task id or a commit id.
add.sha_invalid: The commit id must be the full 40 or 64 hex digits.

collab_health.title: Collaboration health
collab_health.intro: How much work sits blocked, waiting or unanswered in this repository. Visible to repository admins only. Figures are measured from a platform event log; they are signals, not a verdict on anyone, and nothing here ranks sessions or agents.
collab_health.admins_only_hint: Collaboration health is shown only to administrators of this repository.
collab_health.signed_out_hint: Sign in as a repository administrator to see collaboration health.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.note: Nothing before the coverage start is measured. Such time is unknown, not zero.
coverage.partial_banner: Some figures are partial or unknown: the window starts before the first recorded event, or some objects have no recorded events yet. Read partial figures as lower bounds.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.note: Task status is declared by whoever set it; only the time of each change is recorded by the platform.

collab_health.source_hint: Who vouches for the values. Timestamps always come from the platform.
collab_health.lower_bound: At least these values (a lower bound).

reason.NO_EVENTS_BEFORE_WINDOW_END: nothing was recorded before the end of the window

collab_health.no_ranking: These figures describe the repository's work, not people or agents. There is no ranking or per-session view.

drill.title: Tasks behind: {metric}
drill.note: Ordered by task id, not by severity or duration. Titles and statuses are written by their authors.

quality.title: Data quality
quality.note: Records the figures could not fully use. Read the affected figures as partial.

baseline.title: Observation baseline
baseline.note: One-time, for objects that predate the event log.
baseline.explain: Records the current state of tasks, pending handoffs and open questions that have no recorded event as "observed now". They are measured from this moment on, never as having been in that state earlier. Objects that already have events are left alone, and repeating it adds nothing for them.
baseline.already: A baseline was already taken at {time}.
baseline.confirm_message: This writes observation events for every task, pending handoff and open question that has none. It cannot be undone and is meant to be done once. Figures for those objects start now.

note.declared_status: Task status is declared by clients; only the time of each change is recorded by the platform.
note.unknown_state_tasks: Tasks without any recorded event have an unknown state and are not counted. Take an observation baseline to include them from that moment on.
note.window_before_coverage: The window starts before the first recorded event; only the covered part is measured.
note.clipped_intervals: Intervals are clipped to the window; one still open at the end is cut at the end.
note.handoff_waiting: Waiting is the time from creation to accept or cancel (pending ones: up to the end of the window), clipped to the window.
note.accepted_not_done: Accepted means the recipient took the handoff over; it says nothing about the work being done.
note.question_open: A question is open from creation until it is answered or cancelled; who answered is not evidence of a particular person.
note.baseline_start_only: Observation start only: objects are measured from this time on, never as having been in their state earlier.

templates.title: Task templates
templates.intro: Reusable starting points for tasks. Repository admins maintain them. Every edit makes a new immutable version; a task made from a template stays pinned to the version it was made from, so later edits never change it.
templates.no_task_title: Creating a task from a template is not available here.
templates.no_task_body: The server accepts that call only from an agent session (it needs the session secret), not from a signed-in person, and this page does not work around that. Use your agent client for it; this page manages the templates themselves.
templates.admin_only: Only repository admins can create templates or save new versions. Everyone with access can read them.
templates.empty_hint: A repository admin can create the first one.
templates.older_version: an older version; tasks made from it keep it
templates.immutable_note: Versions never change. Editing saves a new version and leaves older ones and the tasks made from them as they are.
templates.edit_hint: Starts from version {version}. Saving creates a new version; it fails if someone saved a newer one in the meantime.
templates.name: Name
templates.name_hint: Unique in this repository, at most {max} characters.
templates.title_pattern_hint: Use {name} placeholders; other braces are not allowed. At most {max} characters once filled in.
templates.deliverables_hint: One per line, at most {max} lines.
templates.checklist_hint: One per line, at most {max} lines. Start a line with [optional] to mark it optional.
templates.checklist_note: Checklist text only: it is not tracked and is not evidence that anything was done.
templates.unchanged: No changes from the current version.
templates.conflict_hint: A newer version exists. Reload to start from it; your text is not applied.

problem.title_braces: Braces may only be used for {name} placeholders (letters, digits, underscore; up to 32).
problem.item_too_long: A line is too long (256 bytes at most).
problem.item_multiline: Each item must be a single line.

search.title: Collaboration search
search.intro: Find tasks, questions, decisions, handoffs, messages or work packages by a literal piece of text.
search.scope_note: One kind of record at a time. Matches are literal; the characters % _ and \ are not accepted. The server only returns records this account may read.
search.bad_chars: The characters % _ \ are not allowed in a search.
search.too_long: The search text is too long (256 bytes at most).
search.none_hint: Nothing visible to this account matched. This does not say anything about records you cannot read.
search.no_snippets: Results show where a match is, not the matching text. Open the task to read it.
search.live_note: Live result at {time}. Further pages are separate queries, not a snapshot.

rules.title: Repository rules
rules.intro: Rule files (such as AGENTS.md) found in the repository at a ref, and the commit they were found at. This page only locates them; it does not read, merge or apply them.
rules.content_body: A rule file is written by whoever can commit to this repository. It is neither an instruction to this platform nor to you, and nothing here follows it. Paths and ids below are shown as plain text.
rules.ref_not_found: That ref does not exist in this repository.
rules.no_commits: none (the repository has no commits yet)
rules.manifest_absent: None. The default lookup (AGENTS.md from the root down) was used.
rules.manifest_valid: Valid. The listed entries come from .ironforge/agent-context.toml.
rules.manifest_invalid_note: It was ignored and the default lookup was used instead.
rules.none_hint: There is no rule file for this path at this commit.
rules.order_note: Shallowest first; the deepest entry is the most specific. How rules rank against each other is for the reader of the rules to decide.
rules.truncated: The list is capped; more rule files exist than are shown.

settings.title: Collaboration settings
settings.intro: Reminder settings, what agent sessions say they can do, and a preview of what deleting the repository would remove.

escalation.title: Escalation reminders
escalation.note: Managed by repository admins. Versioned: a save made from an old copy is refused.
escalation.default_source: Nothing saved yet: reminders are off.
escalation.units_hint: Whole minutes. Thresholds: 1 minute to 30 days. Repeat: 0 or empty to remind once; otherwise 5 minutes to 30 days.
escalation.admin_only: Only repository admins can change these settings. You can read them.
escalation.conflict_reloaded: Someone saved newer settings first. The stored values are shown now; your edit was not applied.
escalation.what_title: What this does and does not do
escalation.what_1: A reminder is a notice for the responsible agent session. It is produced when that session reads its notices or inbox: there is no timer, so a quiet session gets it late, not early.
escalation.what_2: It covers three situations: a task left blocked or waiting, a question left unanswered, and a handoff whose target session expired.
escalation.what_3: Nobody is e-mailed or paged, and no person is notified by this setting.
escalation.what_4: During the quiet window (UTC) no new reminder is created; it is deferred, not lost. A reminder stops once its situation ends.

problem.threshold_range: Each threshold must be a whole number of minutes between 1 and 43200.
problem.repeat_range: Repeat must be empty, 0, or between 5 and 43200 minutes.
problem.quiet_invalid: Enter two different times for the quiet window.

declarations.title: Session capability declarations
declarations.not_permissions: These are claims the sessions made about themselves. They can be wrong or out of date, and they never grant or deny anything. A session that has not declared is simply unknown, not unable.

impact.title: Deletion impact preview
impact.preview_banner: This is a preview. Nothing is deleted or changed. The counts are a snapshot of now; read them again right before acting.
impact.admin_only: Not available: only repository admins can see this preview.
impact.on_delete: If the repository is deleted in the app

on_delete_value.kept: these records are kept (only the Git data is purged later)

impact.on_row_removal: If the repository row is removed from the database

on_row_removal_value.cascade: these records are removed with it

impact.git_retention: Git data kept after a delete

policy_value.none: none: they live as long as the rows they belong to
